text:
deploybot: Scheduled rollout for Orca Health (Dedicated pool) on 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC. Change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Pinning model to redwood/orca:v2.3.1-quant; fallback set. CI checks passed. Runbook: https://go/redwood/runbooks/orca-dedicated-cutover. @Ben Release pls ack
Maria G.: noted. can we confirm latency SLO targets for canary? Orca expects p95 token latency <= 250ms and error_rate < 0.5%
Claire SRE: We'll validate. Plan: phased canary 10%->30%->100% with automated rollback gates. Primary checks: p95 token latency, 5m error rate, OOMs. Dashboard -> https://go/redwood/dashboards/orca-cutover
Sam (CS): Orca PM asked about a short read-only window for telemetry flush. They can tolerate ~2m. Will message them the exact schedule
Ken - Prod Eng: Config pin + runtime flags ready. snippet:
```json
{"model_pin":"redwood/orca:v2.3.1-quant","fallback":"redwood/orca:v2.2.0-fp16","runtime_kernel":"kernel-v7","batching_policy":"auto"}
```
Irina - Security: Heads up: KMS rotation is scheduled same day 2026-04-02 00:00 UTC in their account. Need to confirm key ARN in runbook and ensure no simultaneous rotation jobs.
Ben Release: Requesting final sign-off from SRE + Prod Eng + CS by 2026-04-01 18:00 UTC. If no objections I'll trigger the deploybot canary flip. :thumbsup:
Claire SRE: Ack from SRE. Canary ramp steps: 10% (30m) -> 30% (30m) -> 100% (30m). Auto-rollback if error_rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m OR p95 increases >40% vs baseline for 10m. We'll also watch token-level latencies and KV cache miss rate.
Maria G.: please add a traffic shaping rule to avoid K/V cache warmup spikes during 10% -> 30% ramp. Also capture sample prompts for quality evals.
deploybot: Canary will start at 2026-04-02T02:00:00Z per schedule. Logging to /deploy/logs/1718543210. Notifying #orca-ops.
Sam (CS): Orca PM will be on standby in #orca-ops and will pause traffic if they observe any regressions. I'll keep them on voice for the first two ramps.
Ken - Prod Eng: Fallback/rollback command ready:
```sh
redwoodctl rollback --customer orca --to redwood/orca:v2.2.0-fp16 --reason "canary-rollback"
```
Ben Release: Final sign-off from Release: I approve, proceed with canary. ✅
Irina - Security: KMS team confirmed key ARN included in runbook: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345. No conflicting rotations scheduled in the window.
Claire SRE: Canary started at 02:00 UTC. Initial metrics look stable. Will post updates every 15m.
Claire SRE: Canary step 10% -> metrics: error_rate 0.03%, p95 token latency +6% vs baseline. No OOMs. Proceeding to 30%.
deploybot: Canary 30% at 02:30 UTC. Automation: monitoring hooks active.
Maria G.: collecting prompt/response samples and running quick evals, no quality regressions so far.
Claire SRE: Canary 30% -> metrics green. Ramp to 100% starting now.
deploybot: Rollout to 100% complete at 2026-04-02T02:55:05Z. No rollback triggered. Post-deploy notes: model pinned to redwood/orca:v2.3.1-quant, runtime kernel-v7. Fallback remains redwood/orca:v2.2.0-fp16.
Ben Release: Rolling notes to release channel and adding to release log. Thanks all. :party-parrot:
deploybot: Rollout finished. Summary: duration 55m, no SLO violations, automated gates OK. Postmortem placeholder: https://go/redwood/postmortems/orca-cutover-2026-04-02
